key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the Anahita Wallpaper Changer indicator in the top panel.

key.name: favorites-directory
key.description: Directory path where favorited wallpapers are stored. Defaults to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers/Favorites if empty.

key.name: default-provider
key.description: Provider used when fetching online wallpapers (wallhaven, bing, picsum, loremflickr).

key.name: enable-multi-monitor
key.description: Whether to invoke wchanger with -m for multi-monitor display spanning.

key.name: rotator-enabled
key.description: Whether the extension should rotate wallpapers on an automatic background interval.

key.name: rotation-interval
key.description: Time interval in seconds between automatic background wallpaper rotations (default: 300s = 5m).

key.name: custom-wchanger-path
key.description: Optional custom absolute path to the wchanger executable.
